Mauritius
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Contact: Embassy of Republic of Mauritius, Berlin:
Adresa: 2nd Floor, Burggraf Centre, 84 Kurfurstenstrasse, 10787 BerlinTel: +49 30 26393610Fax: +49 30 26558323E-mail: consular@mauritius-embassy.de berlinemb@mail.gov.mu
Citizens of the Republic of Mauritius are exempted from visa requirement for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days per period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
